summary: Iteration 4: Tested new /api/optimize grid-search endpoint and param-driven /forwardtest/run, plus regression on presets and end-to-end optimizer UI flow. 18/18 pytest cases pass. Frontend optimizer flow works (Trova la migliore config -> projected +50% tile -> Applica e riproduci starts replay with trades).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~880 lines, mixing auth/market/AI/bot/positions/backtest/forwardtest/optimize. Consider splitting into modules (routers/services) for maintainability.
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False; fine for token-based auth but note review request also mentions cookie flows for other apps; here JWT bearer is used consistently.
Optimizer grid iterates all 72 combos sequentially inside async endpoint; can block event loop ~5-15s. Consider running under run_in_executor if concurrency grows.

run_forward_test scoring in optimize uses realized_net divided by max_drawdown; when max_drawdown is 0 it clamps to 0.1 which can inflate score for lucky, low-DD tiny samples. total_trades>=12 minimum mitigates but could be tightened.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_optimize.py covers /api/optimize (US30 + EUR/USD/XAU/USD/GBP/USD parametrized, invalid symbol, and optimized-params passthrough to /forwardtest/run). test_forwardtest.py covers modes balanced/highwinrate/nosl and datasource. Optimizer endpoint takes ~5-15s per call (grid of 72). Frontend testids used: optimizer-run-button, optimizer-projected-annual, optimizer-apply-button, forward-test-panel, forwardtest-run-button, forwardtest-mode-nosl, forwardtest-trades-table.
